There's a fleet, incoming, they're already hitting the taskforce around Corellia proper.|[[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] comm. officer to [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]|}} The '''Battle of Corellia''' took place in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. It resulted in the withdrawal of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces from the [[Blockade of Corellia]] and the formation of the Corellian Confederation, which was soon renamed the [[Confederation]] at the insistence of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] and [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. ==Prelude== The Blockade of Corellia was taking its toll on the system and supplies were very low. But the recent assassinations of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] turned [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] into a potential ally of the [[Five Worlds]]. The Galactic Alliance frigate [[Shamunaar (frigate)|''Shamunaar'']] coordinated all reconnaissance in the [[Both system]] to ensure that they wouldn't come to Corellia's aid. But the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Lumiya]] manipulated former Galactic Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Matric Klauskin]] into taking control of the ''Shamunaar'' and killing the crew by opening the ship to vacuum. He then turned over the frigate to [[Tathak K'roylan]], who would lead Bothan forces to help break the blockade. ==The battle== ===Surprise attack=== {{Quote|We're borked.|''[[Blue Diver]]'' junior officer to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tarla Limpan]]|}} When the Bothan and [[Commenor/Legends|Commenorian]] fleets arrived at the [[Corellian Exclusion Zone]], Corellian forces throughout the system immediately launched from the surface and attacked the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Second Fleet]] in an all-out effort to break the blockade. Aboard the [[Dodonna (Galactic-class)|''Dodonna'']] Admiral [[Tarla Limpan|Limpan]] immediately recognized the poor odds of defeating the combined enemy fleets and ordered the majority of Galactic Alliance forces to attack [[Centerpoint Station]]. Soon the ''Dodonna'', ''[[Blue Diver]]'', and the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] were en route to deal as much damage as possible before retreating. ===Escorting the ''Errant Venture''=== {{Quote|By the way, you're now Ganner Three and Mara's Ganner Four.''"
"''For Ganner Rhysode?''"
"''Can you think of a better name for someone fighting a delaying action?|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|}} As the battle continued [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] launched from the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' to protect it from attacking Corellian forces before it entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. They were soon joined by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] in their [[StealthX]]s and formed [[Ganner Squadron]] which was named after [[Ganner Rhysode]]. The ''Dodonna'' ordered the ''Errant Venture'' to launch all spaceworthy fighters before leaving, which meant more time that the under armed [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was vulnerable. They managed to fight off a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] and six [[I-7 Howlrunner]]s before the ''Errant Venture'' safely entered hyperspace. ===Attack on Centerpoint Station=== At this point there was no hope to defeat the rebel forces so the best option was for the Galactic Alliance task force to focus the majority of their firepower on Centerpoint Station. The ''Blue Diver'' engaged two [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class gunships]] while the ''Dodonna'' and ''Anakin Solo'' assaulted the station. The Bothans used this to their advantage by inflicting a devastating amount of damage to the ''Dodonna'' while all it's [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] were occupied. The Alliance forces managed to leave two large gashes in Centerpoint Station before retreating. ==Aftermath== Overall the battle was a disaster for the Galactic Alliance. Now there was no chance for a negotiated peace with the Corellians. Along with Commenor and Bothawui, [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] also joined the newly formed [[Confederation]]. The loss of planets with major [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] such as Corellia and Fondor were a critical loss to Alliance ship production. The [[Galactic-class battle carrier|''Galactic''-class battle carrier]] ''Dodonna'' was heavily damaged during the battle and spent the rest of the war out of commission being repaired. The Galactic Alliance and Confederation spent the next few weeks of the war launching a series of minor attacks on each other's shipyards such as the [[Raid on the Gyndine Shipyards]]. ==Appearances== *''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]'' {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{SecondGalacticCivilWarNav}} {{Interlang |es=Batalla de Corellia (Segunda Guerra Civil Galáctica) }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Corellia (Second Galactic Civil War), battle of}} [[Category:Battles of Corellia]] [[Category:Battles of the Second Galactic Civil War]]
